step: add 1/2 tsp ground black pepper to the bowl
heat 1 tbsp oil in a non-stick frying pan
cook the tomatoes cut-side down until they start to soften and colour
crack one egg in a bowl
beat the contents of the bowl
scoop the tomatoes from the pan
put tomatoes on a serving plate
add the chopped cilantro to the bowl
pour the egg mixture into the pan
stir gently with a wooden spoon so the egg that sets on the base of the pan moves to enable the uncooked egg to flow into the space
stop stirring when it's nearly cooked to allow it to set into an omelette
transfer omelette to the plate and serve with the tomatoes
